verdict.rationale: AngelList offers an Open Cap Table Format export and Excel reports (angellist-docs-27, angellist-docs-28), plus a built-in AI Tie Out Assistant and Health Checks that flag mismatches between legal documents and the cap table (angellist-docs-7, angellist-docs-8). These are manual or in-platform features, not programmatic agent access: no public API is evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 (angellist-probe-2). The FAQ also says equity customers are being moved to J.P. Morgan and Pulley (angellist-docs-2), which casts doubt on the product's continued availability. Missing for 10: a documented cap table API or other programmatic access for agents, agent-driven reconciliation against an external data room, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
